We just stopped by a random place after the beach, and it turned out to be a perfect choice.
Jun 2026 • Family
After returning from Ky Co, the heat was intense, so we looked for an air-conditioned spot to rest. The place looked spacious from the outside, so we just pulled in without checking any reviews beforehand. We ordered a platter of rolls for four people; at first, it didn't look like enough, but it turned out there was plenty left over even after we’d eaten our fill. My dad is usually picky, but he kept praising the dipping sauce, saying, "Now *this* is the authentic flavor." The only downside was that the rice paper ran out, and ordering more meant an extra charge, which made my mom grumble a bit. Otherwise, I think it’s definitely worth a visit.
